psychological_meaning: Buddha Gold evokes feelings of wisdom, enlightenment, and spiritual wealth. It represents a deep understanding and inner peace, reminiscent of ancient teachings and treasured knowledge. It’s associated with stability, tradition, and a reverence for the past, while also suggesting a sense of hope and prosperity.

real_world_examples.title: Buddhist Temple Decoration
real_world_examples.description: Often used in the gilding and ornamentation of Buddhist temples, symbolizing enlightenment and spiritual richness.

real_world_examples.title: Antique Jewelry
real_world_examples.description: Frequently found in antique jewelry pieces, representing a connection to history and enduring value.
